query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  m.id as meetingId, m.timeSlot, m.status, s.companyName
FROM delegateProfiles dp
JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE dp.firstName LIKE '%Robyn%' AND dp.lastName LIKE '%Collins%'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
